11/5/2026
Dog was laying on bed, handler closed divider and dog sat up, tense, shaking, handler tossed treats, no interest, backed into corner of kennel, tucked head under kurunda bed, handler moved bed slightly until dog lifted head up, able to drape leash over, removed bed from kennel, dog stayed pressed into back corner, tense, tightly closed mouth and furrowed brow. Handler used bite gloves as a precaution, placed bucket in front of dog, dog backing up further into corner, tried to push head around edge of bucket to avoid, handler used lid as a sort board to gently guide dog forward, dog defecating in place, entered bucket, continued to defecate as handler lifted bucket, held lid lightly over top to avoid dog jumping out. Dog stayed still inside bucket, once placed in room dog stayed inside for a moment, then slowly crawled out, darted to corner of room, laid down with tense body, shaking, small amount of feces in corner, handler gave dog a few minutes, then stood and approached to attempt walking dog outside to eliminate. Dog retreated to other corner, would not follow handler outside, handler dropped leash and sat across from dog, speaking softly, dog remained tense, laying on corner and feigning sleep, would tremble when handler looked toward her. After a few minutes handler approached, placing bucket nearby, dog shifting uneasily in place, handler placed a towel over dogs head and placed clip leash, removed towel and placed bucket in front of dog, used lid again to guide dog inside, easily walked in and allowed handler to carry bucket back to kennel, handler placed bucket in front of kennel and dog darted into back half of kennel, removed leash with clip leash.
11/4/2026
Dog was locked in front kennel for AM cleaning. Handler approached kennel front with towel prepared for transport. Dog was on bed, curled up trembling with head tucked. Handler tried to offer treat; dog was not interested. Handler opened gate and began leashing attempts, dog was avoidant and began pacing kennel and attempting to hide. Dog dove under kurunda bed. Handler was able to maneuver bed and tilt up. After several attempts handler was able to secure leash. Handler tried again to offer treats and lure out of kennel, dog refused. Dog was rigid in posture, handler tried to drape towel over, dog was avoidant. Handlers noticed dog had defecated during leashing process. Handler put on safety gloves and attempted to drape towel over to carry. Dog would freeze when towel was placed and remain frozen when handler touched. As soon as handler began scooping motion to lift dog would snap at handler's hand. Handler attempted 3 times to lift dog each time resulting in dog snapping and making contact with handler's glove. Handler ended evaluation due to dog's high levels of FAS. Handler allowed dog a moment to decompress in kennel. Handler then returned and removed leash using leash removal tool. Dog was heavily trembling in corner. Handler returned bed and left dog a small jackpot of treats.
10/28/2026
Arrived in kennel, had been trapped previous day. Behaved as if feral, hiding in corner, did not allow any touching, air snap with touch. Used towels to restrain, applied muzzle for vaccines. Carried to kennel.

Would not be interested in treats.  While handler would be walking, dog would approach handler from behind & start to do an intense sniffing of pant leg, dog started to lick then nip @ pants.  Handler was able to redirect verbally by saying "NO" firmly, dog would lay down then stand up & do a shake off of body, returning to exploring.  Dog would approach handler again, allow more petting while having a relaxed body then started to do zoomies.  Dog would defecate then dragged leash through feces.  Handler picked up leash to wipe off, dog would start to jump up against handler while nipping @ handlers sleeves, able to direct off without issues.  Dog would approach handler from behind again, wrapping front paws around handlers legs & licking @ handlers pant legs, handler would say "NO" firmly again, dog would release & lay down while rolling over to expose belly.  Handler walked away, dog would return to exploring with nose to ground while having a soft tail wag.  Handler approached dog & picked up leash.  Walked back to kennel with a moderate pull on leash while jumping up & walking in a zig zag pattern.  Entered into kennel without issues & removed leash by hand.
11/4/2026
Dog was closed outside for cleaning, standing at gate with soft face and wagging tail. Accepted treats. Sniffed leash for several moments before allowing placement. Exited kennel, walked mostly loose leash, appeared interested in calm dogs, easily startled by reactive ones and kept distance from them. 11/13/2026
Dog is pacing back and forth in kennel. Able to lift drain cover in kennel and move it. Dog is wide eyed and seems pannicked.
11/13/2026
Handler observed kennel in disarray; fecal smearing present on entirety of kennel floor as well as several areas of wall and gate. Drain cover partially removed. Handler called dog, dog approached with soft body language, gentle tail wag. Dog leaned against gate, seeking attention, allowed petting with flat palm through bars.
11/13/2026
Dog was pacing between kennel sides on approach, pupils dilated, tail high. Handler used soft, calming verbal coaxing, dog paced briefly but then stood at gate, wagging tail. Pushed snout against gate once opened but did not resist leash placement, allowed handler to adjust it by hand. Dog exited kennel, strong pull past neighboring kennels. Dog followed additional handlers through S-wing, very strong and forceful pull on leash, breathing hard. Once outside, dog became tense with raised hackles, slowed down, forward posture towards nearby barking dogs. Handler used continuous verbal coaxing to get dog's attention. Dog turned away from kennels, urinated, pulled to follow additional handlers out loading doors. Handler used leash guidance and coaxing to keep dog moving towards J-yard. Walked dog on leash in yard for a couple minutes, dog appeared to settle slightly, handler dropped leash. Dog explored yard, wagged tail when called. Dog allowed petting, did not seek it. Dog became tense after a few minutes, began surveying surroundings outside of yard, vigilant, tail flagged. Handler called dog by name to break focus, scattered treats. Dog ate treats, began pacing fence, pawed at gate. Another dog was being walked outside of yard on back path at a distance; this dog noticed, became focused on other dog with hard posture, tail flagged. Handlers asked that other dog be walked away from yard. This dog remained vigilant and very tense, paced fence quickly, until other dog was out of sight. Dog ran to gate, pawed at it. Handler got dog's attention, was able to pet on back. Dog head-flipped when handler reached for leash; handler waited, tried again, dog head flipped and made a small air snap towards hand. Second handler placed second slip lead instead, then was able to retrieve first leash, hand off to first handler. Walked on single leash for return. Dog had same very strong pull on return. Neighboring dogs had been closed to opposite side. First handler guided dog towards kennel, second handler used second leash to lead dog inside, opened divider, dog ran in. Able to remove both leashes by hand. Dog resumed pacing, began attempting to flip kuranda bed. No interest in high value chew but did begin engaging with stuffed toys when offered.

11/8/2026
Repetitive wall-bounding, pupils dilated, high reactivity to neighboring dog. Would not settle, focused on neighbor, panting hard.
11/7/2026

Dog was pacing yard, front paws against fence, panting heavily, high wagging tail, interacted with handler briefly with wiggly body and wagging tail then continued pacing, ate treats tossed around yard, tried coaxing dog over with more treats but dog was too focused on surroundings, continued pacing and jumping against fence, wouldn't settle. Followed handler into catch pen, as handler was trying to adjust leash wrapped around dog's legs dog jumped up towards handler's face, hander felt saliva but no contact made, dog became focused on surroundings once again allowing handler to pick up leash, strong pull back, pulled hard towards kenneled dogs, used firm leash pressure to redirect away, hesitant to enter kennel, ignored treats tossed inside, handler stepped in and tried guiding dog in, dog resisted, thrashed and grabbed leash. Handler returned dog to inside portion of kennel instead and asked nearby handler for assistance, handler opened divider to try and entice dog to enter kennel,  handler was able to guide dog into kennel with firm leash pressure, as handler was attempting to close door dog pushed out, thrashed and bit leash again, gave dog a moment, dog settled, panting heavily, handler stepped in kennel and was able to guide dog in, exited kennel and used clip leash, dog then jumped against kennel door and began pacing.

Dog constantly leaping and whining while handler observed from a distance.

Handler approached kennel back; Dog was outside for AM cleaning; Dog was sitting; mild pant; ears down; soft stare; Handler unlocked door and held leash in opening; Dog came forward allowing easy leashing; Dog walked at handlers pace; zig zag walking; Handler secured leash and was able to pet dog with no issues;  Dog ignored dogs in passing; timid; unsure; quicker walking past reactive dogs;  tail tucked; Once in yard handler dropped leash and allowed dog time to decompress; Dog sniffed briefly and walked over to fence line; Whining at fence line exit; Handler  would call by name; dog would acknowledge and look over; Handler would stand up and approach dog; Dog would just whine and look at gate; handler would reach hand out and pet; dog would come forward and allow petting; tail wagging; Handler attempted to engage in play and distract dog; Dog would become loose and zoomied around yard; chase after small stuffed toy; picked up 2 different times and dropped on ground; after a few minutes dog would disengage and stand near exit again; light whining; Handler would stand with dog at fence line and pet; dog allowed petting; did come forward once and leaned into petting; tail wagging; handler would call by name and dog would respond; allowed petting all over with no issues; Dog is treat motivated; took treats gently; sat for treats; Dog remained at fence line for remainder of evaluation; When time to go handler approached; Grabbed leash and walked dog to exit; dog followed;  loose leash walking neutral bodied and tail aligned; walked out of yard and to kennel with ease; ignored dogs in passing; wary of environment; still neutral bodied and swift tail wagging walking back to kennel; head ducking when sounds became louder; entered kennel; handler gave jackpot of treats to end on positve interaction;
11/8/2026
Dog was in back kennel peering through portal on approach. Dog began alarm barking once handler was in sight. Handler tried to lure dog forward but dog would not come in. Handler lowered guillotine and reapproached from back. When approaching from back kennel dog was standing with front paws on gate, dog got down as handler approach. Dog then sat at gate and allowed leashing. Handler draped leash overhead and secured. Dog was lip licking with wide eyes. Handler opened gate and dog followed to nearby PY, dog walked with mild/moderate pull. Once in PY handler attached leash extension and adjusted leash stopper, dog was then released. Handler sat on bench allowed dog time and space to decompress. Dog paced around perimeter of yard and began climbing on landscaping in PY. Handler tried to call dog over a few times dog would stare with furrowed brows and tense posture and then walk away. Dog paced around for about 10 minutes, maintaining rounded posture. When volunteers and other dogs would pass by yard, dog would stiffen briefly until they were out of sight. After some time handler called dog over to catch pen, dog followed and allowed leash retrieval. Handler then placed clip leash and walked dog back to kennel. Dog was hesitant to enter, handler lifted guillotine and stepped in with dog, dog followed. Handler then removed leash using clip leash.
11/7/2026
Dog was kenneled outside for AM cleaning, dog sitting at door, tense, wide eyes, no interest in treats, stare at handler. Handler reached in leash, dog sniffed it briefly but then easily allowed leash placement, handler slowly opened door and dog refused to come out, darting eyes, v shaped lip, watching barking dogs in nearby kennels, handler tossed treats but dog still showed no interest, handler tried walking dog in the opposite direction, dog would take a hesitant step or two forward then back up into kennel, handler tried to encourage dog to walk out for another minute then used moderate leash pressure to get dog moving, once out of the kennel dog followed handler to yard, mild pull. Handler added drag line, dog went straight to catch pen on far side of yard, tense, low tail, ears back. Came up to handler on bench and allowed brief petting, looking around yard, walked away to sniff and explore, stayed alert, hyper vigilant, stood by catch pen for a while, handler called to dog and dog trotted up to handler continued to allow attention but did not solicit. Volunteer walked dog past the yard, this dog stood at fence watching, no reaction, alert. After a few more minutes dog began trying to dig under catch pen gate, handler walked closer, sat on nearby chair and called to dog, dog approached, allowing all petting, gradually sitting down and leaning into handler. After a few minutes handler picked up leash, added clip leash, dog did not follow out of yard, needed light leash pressure to guide back into building. Dog would not go into kennel, handler stepped in first and dog followed, handler backed out as dog tried to push out, would sit with face pressed through door opening for a moment before eventually backing up and allowed leash removal with clip leash.
11/4/2026
Growling at handler and others in lobby. Owner walked dog into triage and applied muzzle. Owner stayed with dog to facilitate easier vaccination. Hard stare, low growl from dog in triage. Used clip leash to remove slip lead.

Soft face, sitting at outside kennel gate, gently wagging tail. Sniffed and licked hand through gate.
11/12/2026
Dog did not eat dry kibble offered previous day. Will be adding 2 TBS of canned food during PM feeding if dog does not eat dry kibble offered from AM feeding.
11/8/2026
Greeted handler with soft wiggly body, wagging tail, came forward to solicit attentions. Wary of leash, tucked tail, hunched over body, head lowered and whale eye, slowly backing away so divider was closed. Would come forward to solicit attentions with handler as handler knelt down at front of kennel but would retreat back quickly if leash was presented, able to continue baby talking and petting dog when not presenting leash, able to lasso as dog turned away from handler when presenting leash. Froze in place, furrowed brow, tail tightly tucked, would walk into taxi on own once positioned at front of kennel. Rode fine to small play yard, soft eyes when petted, very timid. Once in yard dog was hesitant to exit taxi, pancaked and tense bodied, would soften when approached with relaxed ears and soft eyes when petted, only exited taxi when tipping taxi over. Hunched over body, tail tucked, head lowered, very timid, hid behind taxi remainder of evaluation, no interest in treats offered but allowed handler to approach and pet, when picking up leash dog scurried into taxi quickly and pancaked, some trembling in back legs. Rode fine back to kennel, accepted pets throughout. Would not exit taxi into kennel, allowed handler to scoot backside out of taxi for dog to slowly walk rest of self into kennel, able to slowly approach and remove leash by hand.
11/7/2026
Dog was at front of kennel, wiggly body language, soft face. Handler was able to place leash easily, then dog retreated onto bed, still, head turned away. Handler called to dog, spoke softly, dog slowly exited kennel, walked to wing door and then froze, began thrashing on leash, pulling back into building. Handler was able to coax dog back towards door, then used leash pressure to guide dog rest of way out. Once outside, dog froze, crouched down, would not look at handler, no response to treats or coaxing. Second handler brought taxi, positioned it close, dog turned and stepped into taxi on own. Rode well to small yard. Handler was able to adjust leash stopper, then tilted taxi down. Dog remained in taxi for most of evaluation, occasionally taking small steps towards edge, air-scenting. Refused treats, tolerated gentle petting on top of head. Handler gave dog extra time, dog remained in taxi. After a few more minutes, handler approached, crouched, offered treat by hand, dog accepted. Continued taking treats, tolerated more gentle petting, slowly stepped out of taxi for treat trail. Briefly explored yard, tail tucked. Approached handler cautiously, accepted more treats, tolerated all petting on head and behind ears, skin crawled when touched on body. Handler brought taxi over, tried coaxing dog inside; dog wagged tail but remained seated in corner of yard. When handler picked up leash, dog thrashed once, appeared fearful, settled when coaxed, stepped into taxi. Allowed handler to place clip lead. Dog rode well, calm, laying down. Entered kennel from taxi, began retreating outside as handler removed leash with clip lead. Once leash was removed, dog softened, began wagging tail while outside. Handler stepped into kennel, dog approached, wagged tail, allowed petting through divider, accepted more treats.
11/4/2026
Sitting in back corner, ears pinned, tail wagging, slowly came forward with verbal coaxing, low posture, took treats gently, remained soft with wagging tail. Requesting full eval due to finder notes.

dog was stiff body, tail tucked, did approach and allowe petting, allowed finder to carry into kennel with no issues. does not walk on leash

sections.evaluation_comments:
11/13/2026
Demand barking at front of kennel, soft and wiggly, easy to leash. Walked with light pull, tail wagging. No issues directing to sick yard. Dog explored yard, relieved self, frequently checked in with handler and allowed all petting & handling. Brief whining by gate, returned to handler when called. Very affiliative and attention-seeking. Light pull on return, passed several staff members without issue. Dog directed self into kennel, allowed leash removal by hand.
11/12/2026
Assisted with pulling dog for AM cleaning. Dog approached handler with wiggly body and wagging tail, front paws on door soliciting attention, took treats. took a few attempts to place leash due to jumping and pacing, once leashed easy walk to yard. Affiliative with handler, soft body and wagging tail, front paws on lap soliciting attention, allowed petting all over, took treats gently. Handler walked dog back to kennel, while waiting for kennel to be ready a second handler approached, dog solicited attention with soft body and wagging tail, allowed pets. A third male handler approached and kneeled nearby, spoke softly to dog, dog was hesitant to approach, male handler offered treats, dog slowly approached with low wagging tail and took treats from hand, returned to lead handler. Male handler offered more treats, dog approached again with low wagging tail, took treats then returned to handler. Handler was then able to return to kennel and remove leash by hand.
11/12/2026
Handler was cleaning kennel and dog did nothing. Others handlers were called to shift dog.
11/11/2026
Updating level to NHO status
11/9/2026
Laying on bed with tense body, hard staring handler and low growling, no interest in treats offered or coaxing. Started to slowly cower away when presented leash, able to place leash with no issues. Walked behind handler on way to sick yard, stop n go, wary of handler otherwsie no issues walking to yard. In yard hard stared handler when placing leash stopper, paced by play yard exit as handler walked away, would spend all of time in yard laying/sitting near play yard exit with ears alert, wide eyed, low growls if approached by handler, chuffs at handler as handler walked away. Tolerant of handler kneeling down to let dog sniff but dog will start to cower away from handler, some gentle jumping up onto play yard exit gate. Able to recover leash and place clip leash with no issues. Walked with some pulling back to kennel, walked into kennel on own, used clip leash for leash retrieval.
11/7/2026
Laying on bed; handler approached; verbally coaxed; opened kennel door; dog approached right away; soft; tail wagging; constantly coughing; sat at front; allowed handler to place leash over head; exited; walked well; froze when female volunteer walked past; continued walking. In yard, approached handler; allowed for all petting; soft; explored; frequently checked in with handler; took treats gently; approached yard fence when familiar staff approached; sniffed through fence; brief tail wags; continued exploring; would approach handler when coaxed; soft; tail wagging; leaned into petting. Walked well back to kennel; entered kennel; allowed for leash removal.
11/5/2026
On approach, dog was curled up on kuranda bed, watching handler approach w/ furrowed brow, moist soft eyes, ears flat to sides of head, lips pulled into a bit of a grimace. As handler greeted & spoke to her in soft, bright tone, she would occasionally shift/adjust, turn face away, issued a couple of whiny groans but otherwise did not stir much. All movement appeared sluggish & laborious for her. No interest in coming closer to claim treats handler offered (liver-flavored small training treats).
Handler was able to decoy-step into kennel, reach and gently leash dog, stood w/ arm outstretched into keennel to keep it as loose as possible, stood to side of open kennel gate to offer unobstructed path out, dog did not rise from bed. Handler closed door to room/5-pack entry and stood by it to ensure no entry & opened dog's kennel, moved away from it completely, dog still did not rise from bed. After several minutes to allow her opportunity to come out, handler opted to end session. Handler decoy-stepped into kennel, offered treats slowly & gently to dog by hand. She softly snuffled at them, tentatively ate a few, handler deposited the rest of jackopt on her bed in front of her, gently removed leash by hand.
11/4/2026
Dog was lying down on kuranda bed when approaching kennel while having eyes closed.  Able to verbally coax to lift head & approach front of kennel.  Presented leash, dog would become relaxed while opening kennel gate with a wiggly body.  Leashed without issues.  Walked to sick PY while having a relaxed body, stopping to do a full body stretch while yawning then continued to walk to PY.  Would explore with a soft body & tail wag.  Approached handler on own, allowing all petting & taking treats gently.  Not interested in toys.  Able to call dog over for more petting.  Dog would return to exploring with nose to ground while sniffing.  Allowed handler to approach & pet while dog would be sniffing nose to ground.  Picked up leash & walked back to kennel without issues.  Entered into kennel & allowed leash removal to be done by hand.
11/4/2026
Dog did not eat dry kibble offered previous day. WIll be adding 2 TBS of canned food during PM feeding if dog does not eat dry kibble offered in AM feeding.
11/2/2026
Dog was standing @ front of kennel with a relaxed & wiggly body.  Opened kennel gate & presented leash, dog would retreat to kuranda bed, would roll over to expose belly, would not come forward.  Able to step fully into kennel & drape leash onto dog while dog would be lying down.  Walked out of kennel with verbal coaxing.  Entered into PY with a relaxed body.  Would explore with nose to ground.  Not interested in treats or toys.  Would approach handler & allow all petting without issues.  Returned to exploring, able to approach dog & pet.  Dog would follow handler to bench, would place front paws onto bench while leaning in for more petting.  Picked up leash & walked back to kennel.  Entered into kennel without issues & allowed leash removal to be done by hand.
11/1/2026
Low growling on approach with tail tightly tucked, head lowered, pancaking onto bed, no interest in treats or coaxing, tense/stiff bodied. Able to approach and place leash with no issues, not making eye contact with handler. Wary of handler throughout walk to small play yard, ears pinned back, wide eyed, walking behind handler with tail tucked. In yard dog was distant from handler all of time in yard, wary of handler, low growling and alarm barking at handler as handler sat away from dog, tense bodied, wide eyed, pacing near play yard exit. Startled by reactive dogs outside of yard, would not come to handler for treats or coaxing. tenses up and tolerates petting when approached but did not seek out attentions, will low growl as handler walks away. Walked back to kennel with no issues, walked into kennel quickly and allowed handler to remove leash by hand.
10/31/2026
Laying on bed when approached, slightly tense, approached front with looser body and tail wagging when offered treats, backed away with lowered tail when leash presented, offered treats through loop, backed away during first attempt, stayed at front and allowed leashing during second attempt with this method, exited kennel willingly, walked on loose leash to small play yard, brief hesitations along the way, tense body with low tail when outside, shifty gaze, paced yard, solicited attention, several times, refused treats, walked dog to EET office, moderate pulling, rushed past kennel areas, loose body and more neutral tail carriage with some tail wagging once in office, took treats eagerly, solicited attention from multiple female staff including unfamiliar staff, explored room, briefly interacted with puzzle toy, walked back to kennel with light pull, entered kennel willingly, removed leash by hand.
10/30/2026
Soft face, body low, fast tail wag on approach. Retreated to bed when handler opened kennel, allowed handler to step in and place leash. Dog exited kennel. Walked close to handler, tail tucked, easily startled. Needed coaxing and redirection on leash when passing reactive dogs. In yard, dog was affiliative with handler, sought attention, allowed all petting. Began pacing yard, tense, nervous of surroundings. Handler would gently put hands on dog as dog paced, dog would slow and lean in. Moderate nervous pull on return, entered kennel easily, allowed leash removal by hand. Became soft and wiggly as handler closed gate.
10/29/2026
Assisting ACT with AM cleaning* Low growling on approach with tense body and ears alert, hard staring handler with no interest in treats offered, started to hunch over body as handler presented leash. Able to place large loop over dog with no issues. Exited kennel with some pulling on leash, tail tucked, wary of handler turning to look at handler throughout walk to small play yard. In yard dog would tense up when placing leash stopper, little eye contact with handler, tense bodied. Dog appeared conflicted towards handler throughout time in yard, distant from handler but will follow handler if handler walked around yard, if handler sat down dog would retreat to corner of yard jumping onto fence line and pacing, began alarm barking/low growling while hard staring if handler approached with stiff body, no interest in treats offered, would turn head away and not look at handler if fully approached and tolerated petting on head but due to dog's wariness of handler pets were brief. No issues returning to kennel, continued to be wary of handler on way back to kennel, walked into kennel on own, allowed handler to slowly remove leash by hand as dog stood near food bowl.
10/25/2026
Dog was sitting in bed, wide-eyed, slightly stiff body. Handler crouched, used "baby-talk" coaxing. Dog softened, head low, brief tail wags. Allowed gentle petting under chin, cowered away from petting over top of head. Easy to leash with large loop. Dog needed lots of coaxing but eventually hopped out of kennel. Walked quickly, tail tucked, some zig-zag. Very easily startled, nervous of surroundings. Handler initially took dog to quiet M&G room. Dog paced room, would approach handler briefly, allow petting, then continue to pace. Very interested in treats, took them eagerly, put front feet onto handler's leg. Wagged tail, allowed more petting. Dog ran to door, whined. Handler walked dog to outside yard for potty break. Dog was very nervous of reactive dogs in indoor kennels, cowered back, needed coaxing and leash guidance to pass them. In yard, dog paced, sniffed, relieved self. Dog would come to handler when called, allowed petting, but was easily distracted and would run off, continuing to pace yard with tail tucked. Male handler entered yard. First handler kept hold of leash. Dog immediately began deep whining, then low growling at male handler. Hackles raised, tail tucked, tense body. Dog kept distance from male handler. Male handler crouched, offered hand, dog slowly got closer, sniffed hand, tolerated petting on top of head but remained tense, then backed away and retreated behind female handler. Male handler exited yard. First handler walked dog back inside. When standing still, dog would pace circles on leash around handler, would not settle. Entered new 5-pack kennel easily, leash removed by hand. Dog softened, wagged tail as handler placed food bowl inside kennel.
10/29/26 05:55 Updating color status
10/23/2026
while taking her out of kennel noticed no pee or poop in kennel. Went to play yard and peed and pooped alot.
10/22/2026
Laying on bed with some tense body, ears alert, little eye contact with handler. Remained in place as handler placed leash, started to come forward to exit kennel on own but froze, gently accepted treat before handler was able to scoot dog out of kennel, walked with easy leash pull to small play yard, tucked tail, wary of handler with constant looking back at handler, will freeze up on walk if too close to handler but able to coax thru, startled by reactive dogs in passing. In play yard dog tolerated petting when placing leash stopper but quickly evaded away from handler, went potty, spent all of evaluation distant from handler, pacing with tail tucked and tense body, would allow handler to slowly approach to kneel down and pet but did not solicit attentions, wide eyed, ears alert, tense body. Dog would soften for female staff members that approached fence line, jumping on fence to sniff with neutral tail and softer body while making quick side eye towards handler if approached, retreats from handler. Dog had a moment of alarm barking with stiff body when approached by handler but settled, no interest in treats offered. Picked up leash and walked back to kennel with no issues, wary of handler reaching down to carry into kennel but allowed all handling, tensed up body with wide eyes, subtle attempt to pull away. Placed into kennel and removed leash by hand with no issues.
10/21/2026
Timid, tense body, hunched over. Allowed restraint for vaccines. Carried to kennel.

sections.evaluation_comments:
11/12/2026
on approach k9 at front of kennel with kennel mate, soft wiggly body. Once kennel door was opened both k9s retreated to back corner of kennel and huddled together. Handler able to easily leash k9 and slowly pick up without issue. K9 was stiff body at first but once being held k9 relaxed and leaned into handler. Handler carried to clinic, placed into pre-op kennel with no issues, k9 came forward with soft and wiggly body, licking handlers hands as kennel door was closed.
11/11/2026
Dog was separated from kennel mate when handlers approached. Alarm barked as handlers entered room, retreated to back of kennel when approached, tense body, growling, came forward when offered treats by hand but was easily startled and retreated again, wouldn't approach with verbal coaxing, handler placed treats in dish and stepped back, dog came forward and ate treats, retreated again when approached. Handler opened kennel door, dog came forward looking past handler, retreated when presented with leash, growling, dodged leash placement, after a few attempts able to place leash with large loop, paced side to side, no longer interested in treats, side eyed when attempting to pet. Handler presented blanket, dog sat up on hind legs pressing body into corner, bared teeth, flailed as handler picked up, settled once in arms, able to carry to small yard with no issues, tense and trembling. Dog ran around yard, soft body and wagging tail when interacting with handlers, front paws on lap soliciting attention, allowed petting all over, jumped on bench and leaned into handler, not interested in treats, appeared wary of surroundings at times, would freeze and scan environment, softened and became wiggly again when handler pet, continued running around yard with kennel mate. Handler picked up leash, leash became tangled with kennel mate's, dog began thrashing as leash was being pulled, once settled handler was able to pick up and carry back to kennel, returned and removed leash by hand.
11/10/2026
Able to separate from kennel mate while using treats to coax then closed kennel divider.  Would start to low growl once separated from kennel mate while lifting & curling front paw up.  Offered more treats in hand then placed a large loop leash onto dog.  Dog would start to pace in kennel while keeping close to back wall of kennel, mouth open wide while panting heavy & being whale eyed.  Handler would place a towel over dog, dog would keep pacing & pawing @ towel.  Handler removed towel & would coax dog forward then placed towel over dog, dog would attempt to jump out & into handlers arms.  Handler placed towel to be draped over arms then attempted to lift dog out of kennel, dog would jump out of handlers arms & land on ground.  Would start to pull back & bite @ leash, able to settle.  Handler would place a towel over dog, dog would start to walk on leash.  Handler would use behavior tote lid to help guide dog to walk, dog would start to pull back & thrash on leash once outside of room.  Handler would attempt to coax dog into behavior tote, dog would dart past handler when closing lid.  Able to coax dog to keep walking to M&G room.  Would explore room with kennel mate while having a relaxed body.  Would approach both handlers & allow all petting without issues.  Gently took treats.  Would appear to know "SIT" for treats.  Would start to pace along room walls with kennel mate, able to call dog over & pet throughout body while kennel mate would continue to pace in room.  Assistant handler would kneel down & was able to slowly pick up dog by hands then placed into handlers lap.  Slowly picked up dog once in lap & carried back to kennel while allowing petting.  Removed leash by hand then quickly closed kennel gate once back in kennel.
11/9/2026
No issues separating from kennel mate. Low growling with stiff body, wide eyed, pacing and circling in kennel, no interest in treats offered or tossed near. Whale eye and stiff bodied when placing leash, would low growl if attempting to pet, sniffed treat offered but did not eat. Attempted to drape towel over but dog would become erratic, thrashing and low growling out of towel. Applied bite gloves and let dog settle, attempted to drape towel over once more and when lifting dog would become frantic, biting at towel, thrashing and airsnapping towards handlers hand when head came out of towel. Dog would continue to pace in kennel and low growl when attempting to recover leash, leash fell off on own. Due to rising levels of FAS and safety concerns unable to remove from kennel.
11/3/2026
Tense body, wide eyed, pulls back and thrashes when leash pressure is applied. Allowed hnadler to blanket wrap, allowed restraint for vaccines. Carried to kennel.
